skill.summary: Deploys a real token on Ape.Store within the BASE blockchain using user-provided name, symbol, description, and optional image.

latestVersion.changelog:
ape-store 1.0.0

- Initial release of apestore-token-creator.
- Enables real token deployment on Ape.Store on the BASE blockchain.
- Runs a specific bash command to create tokens with user-provided name, symbol, and description (and optional image).
- Only confirms creation with actual transaction hash and block number after running the command.
